name: Dino Farm
summary:
Dino Farm is a dinosaur farm simulator focused on capturing, managing, and selling dinosaurs, while defending them from zombies at night.

During the day, explore the world to find and capture different dinosaurs. Manage your farm, take care of your dinos, and decide which ones to keep or sell. Each decision affects how your farm develops and how well you can handle upcoming threats.
